    Delete Ceremony

    Delete Ceremony?

    Ceremony comes off the schedule, the RSVP and Your Weekend, and off every invitation link that names it.

    The 5 guests invited to it are no longer invited.

    Nobody has answered its RSVP yet, so no answers are lost. This cannot be undone: to bring it back, add it again and invite everyone again.
